resources.string: SafeMobile Accessibility Guard

When enabled, SafeMobile inspects only package-installer windows for APK installation prompts. It does not collect unrelated screen text or passwords. Cancellation is best-effort and Android may restrict it.
Download Sentinel & Interceptor
Best-effort, permission-dependent protection for APK installer prompts and new APK/EXE downloads. It may interrupt legitimate sideloads and cannot guarantee interception.
